name: Play report

title: 'Play report: '
labels: play-report
---

Nobody except the author has played this by hand for long, so ordinary reports are valuable, including "it all worked".
Describe what you saw in words. Please do not attach screenshots of game data, game files, saves or CD keys.

**Setup**
- Mac and macOS:
- Version or commit:
- Display (window or full screen, resolution, any `OD2_DISPLAY`):
- Hero (class, level, new or imported, difficulty):

**What you played** (acts, areas, how long)

**What worked well**

**What felt wrong** (controls, walking, clicking, skills, monsters, items, quests, UI, sound and music, performance)
Say what you did, what happened and what you expected. Sound and music have never been confirmed by a human listen, so notes there help a lot.

**Did save and reload work?** (quit with Cmd+Q, start again with the same hero: gold, level, items, waypoints)

**Crashes or error dialogs** (paste the relevant lines of `~/Library/Logs/OpenDiablo2/OpenDiablo2.log`)
